Saved result figure Show a genuine rank-one nonlocal kernel and finite-temperature occupations in a three-wave periodic educational model. Authored linear3-wave Hamiltonian with independent-particle mean Fermi occupations, not an integer-particle canonical many-body ensemble. No self-consistent Hartree/XC, element-fitted norm-conserving PSP, real metal, general material or longMD validation. Equations and problem definitions Authored rank-one periodic linear model and finite-N Helmholtz forces. No real metal/element pseudopotential/norm conservation/Hartree-XC/long MD claim. N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble.
